name: 1 Hour Consultation
subtitle: One hour, one to one. Me, Reiss Davies Ausar C.P.T, and you
standfirst: An hour, one to one, with me. Book online and an email follows with instructions to arrange a time. This is not a medical consultation, and it does not replace one.
body: An hour, one to one, with me. I've been behind the counter on Smithdown Road since 2024, and selling online since 2019 before that. Book online and an email follows with instructions to arrange a time. The call itself runs as a private audio call.

Say it plainly: this is not a medical consultation, and it does not replace one. What it is: a conversation about nutrition, herbal protocol, lifestyle, knowledge of cellf, and whatever you bring to it. No script, no promised outcome. I answer what you ask.

What I haven't confirmed yet: whether the hour also runs in person at 599 Smithdown Road, what to bring beforehand, what you leave with after. This is the page people trust most, so those answers go in properly rather than guessed at, and you'll find the open questions listed below.
